text:
**Best fit for most weekend tent campers: the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100W solar panel kit.** It pairs a compact 288Wh LiFePO₄ power station with a 600W inverter—enough for phones, lights, and a laptop, and potentially a night of CPAP use without the humidifier. The included panel can refill it in about four hours of good sun, according to [Dealectric’s camping-kit guide](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-tent-camping).

The listed price is **$489.99**; the guide says code **DEALECTRIC** takes $24.49 off. [See the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit).

One caveat: 288Wh is a modest battery, so it’s better for small electronics than high-draw appliances. And solar charging depends on placing the panel in direct sun—shade can slow it substantially.
